profileText: a Representative from Virginia; born in Houston, Harris County, Tex., September 26, 1986; graduated from Clear Lake High School, Houston, Tex., 2004; B.A., Tulane University, New Orleans, La., 2008; J.D., Northwestern University, Chicago, Ill., 2013; staff, United States Representative Suzanne Kosmas of Florida, 2009-2010; staff, Senate Judiciary Committee, 2011; staff, White House Office of the Chief Technology Officer, 2015-2017; lawyer; business owner; member of the Virginia state house of delegates, 2020-2024; member of the Virginia state senate, 2024; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
